If SdVersionDrivenFindBehavior is set to MINIMUM_MINOR_VER- SION the following points shall be considered by the Service Discovery module: • the Minor Version shall be set to the minimum acceptable required minor version in the configuration • Service Discovery shall use 0xFFFF FFFF (ANY) for the FindService entry, which means that services with any minor version shall will be returned
